title: FDR's 1937 Desert Game Range guarded by anti-aircraft guns 'to protect bighorn sheep'
place_text: Desert Game Range / Sheep Peak, Nevada

tellings.quote: Now, the Desert Game Range was set up in the time of Franklin D. Roosevelt.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years with tall white aliens near Area 51, says the Desert Game Range around Sheep Peak in Nevada was set up under Franklin D. Roosevelt, in 1937, and was guarded by anti-aircraft guns, supposedly to protect bighorn sheep. He tells Michels this on the show, drawing on what park rangers said and on a book called Millennial Hospitality, and to him the guns suggest the land was hiding something far bigger than sheep.
